message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor who has a smoke alarm in every room—yes, even the bathroom! I teased her about being gloriously over-prepared, but then I realized she has a solid escape plan for her family. It got me thinking about my own setup. 🏡 I might not have alarms in every nook and cranny, but I do have a kitchen safety routine that keeps us all on our toes. It’s all about finding that balance, right? How do you keep your home safe without going full-on safety ninja?
